adaptive_rules.coach_note: Jeeps: inspect track bar, drag link, and ball joints after rocky trails — death wobble precursors matter.
Subarus: protect the oil pan / transmission with skids if you scrape often; milky oil after water is urgent.
Lifted or oversized tires change braking and ball-joint angles — align and torque to the upfitter's specs.
Higher-mile trail vehicles: prioritize steering play and differential leaks before remote trips.

risk_confirm.body: Improper recovery (standing in the path of straps, using worn straps, winching without training) can cause severe injury. Highway speeds on aired-down tires can cause blowouts. When unsure, find a nearby shop or trained recovery pro.
